topic_title: Dangers of Night Driving & Overdriving Headlights
prompt: What are the typical effective illumination distances for low-beam and high-beam headlights?

options.text: Low beams illuminate 150 to 200 feet; high beams illuminate 350 to 400 feet
Low beams illuminate 50 feet; high beams illuminate 1,000 to 1,500 feet
Low beams illuminate 500 feet; high beams illuminate 2,000 feet forward
Low beams and high beams provide identical one-hundred-foot beam ranges
